rows.Origin:
Bred by Simon (Simó) Dot (Spain, before 1969).
Introduced in France by Florida S.A.R.L. in 1969 as 'Jardinier Ortiz'.
rows.Bloom: Red, carmine-red reverse. Currant-red. Moderate fragrance. up to 28 petals. Large, very double, borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage:
Duet (hybrid tea, Swim, 1960) ×
Bajazzo (hybrid tea, Kordes, 1961)
